lines: Why is my face on this game’s cover,
and I get a huge cash prize for clearing it?!
This reeks of a scam!
This is an eyesight test!
So I just have to spot the differences?
Let us give it a shot!
How could a game possibly scam me, anyway? Let us start!
Oh, this color is different level cleared!
This one is so obvious!
Ah! This one is a bit trickier!
Uh, which one was it again ...
oh! There is a hint it is trembling in fear!
Do I really have to click that one?
No! Sorry, but I am clicking you!
Hmm, are those two not on good terms?
That last round must have pissed one of them off ...
pointing back
now! It is a fifty fiftieths shot,
I would say. This one should be fine.
The game bugged out—cannot click anywhere!
Those two definitely have some beef!
And that beef is my fault—sorry about that!
I will just head
to the next level—this must be the button for it,
so let us click it.
Hiss ... man, this is so hard to find!
Hmm, tapping one randomly should not hurt, right? This one ...
let us tap another one ... one, two ...
what does that even mean?!
Ah! Minesweeper?!
How did this turn into a Minesweeper game?!
I am a pro at this piece of cake!
This one is a mine yep, no problem there.
Just a random click easy peasy!
okay! All cleared!

Huh? Why have not I cleared it yet?! This is a spot the difference, eye test game! This ... this mine's color is different from the others yep, you! So, at its core, it is a spot the difference game, then?
Hmm! I think this creator is a genius
so each level should have a different gimmick!
Let me just click one at random ... Strawberry!
Ah hahahaha!
Flip and match pairs! O K, let me see.
ok, so this is a chili pepper!
Chili pepper, ok, tomato,
this is an apple this one so just these two left, right?
Number clearance yet after all,
it is a spot the difference game!
Obviously, they are all red hued fruits and veggies,
and you are yellow!
Could it be ...
I have completely figured out this creator's brain now!
So easy! Found the Cheese!
Warma, hahaha! Hold on, WHY is Warma in this game?!
Argh!
Never mind that let us keep going!
Mmm, clearly, two colors are different!
Click it again, only one odd color in the picture,
but there are two!
Hey, there are two of them!
What is this window mean?
Oh, I can move it,
I can move it! What if I ...
Just one spot, huh?
Now there is only one!
I am a genius!
Uh huh, wait, wait how do I control this Tetris?
Oh! Oh, the D pad on the keyboard!
ok, ok, I will place it here.
So easy! Wait, Tetris all of a sudden?!
Hey, is not this falling speed a tad fast?
Way faster than any I have played before!
Leave it to me,
leave it to me!
no worries, no worries—drop it here, right here!
Oh! A vertical bar falling so fast!
It seems to be speeding up!
A I! OK, put it down, put it down
I am fine, leave it to me!
I am a pro at this stuff!
I am!
Okay, no worries, no worries! Ugh, put it here, over here! ok whoa, whoa, whoa, backwards!
No, no, no!
I am fine, I am fine!
still got time
hey, that is way too fast!
This falling speed is picking up! Whoa hey!
Huh?! Is this even meant for humans to play?!
So I have to win to clear it?!
Huh? There is no retry button?!
Is this a dead save?!
Wait— in my memory,
Tetris has blocks of all different colors,
but here, every single block is dark blue!
So, this is a deep blue level!
So, is there any different color in this level?
Oh! This word is red!
What if I click on it?
I get you, dev why dough all of a sudden?!
Here is that stainless steel bowl, with some flour in it!
How to make dough rise?
I have made dough before,
so let me try—
Step two after adding flour should be adding water, right?
Too much water? Add more flour!
Too much flour? Add more water!
First, add the water, then give it a stir
mix them all together into a paste, and then eat it up!
Let me think ...
Normally,
Stirred into a batter now, you can press it down a bit.
Phone scrolling ? ! Is not now the time to scroll
my hands are still covered in flour !
Dude am I supposed to be making dough while starving?!
I am so hungry just now, I was sane enough to eat it for real!
Devour must be an enchantment!
I think I should cover it with plastic wrap
and give it some time
only then can the dough rise! Okay,
plastic wrap on! Let us wait! Wait, wait, wait!
Who is talking?!  Upstart Dough ?
What is that?! The dough rose up,
so yeah, the dough  rose ! As in,  upstart   rose ?
Ha ha! Finally the day I strike it rich!
this happy?! so you are the one who made me rich, right?!
Ah! Mmm, he gave me thousand bucks!
This level’s prize is now thousand!
Before, each level paid ten bucks, this one pays one grand!
Wow! Hahaha, thank you!
Navigation starting, Turn left in fifty meters,
navigation starting!
Do I have to drive?!
Wait, wait, wait,
this color is obviously wrong,
cannot click it!
Oh! There is a cyclist in the bottom left corner!
So, am I supposed to ride that bike to the finish line?
Let me give it a shot
let us drive! Turn left! Turn left ahead!
Turn left ahead again?!
Do I really have to go this roundabout way?!
Bear right ahead! Turn! Keep going right!
one hundred meters ahead,
turn right one hundred meters
and you are good!
This little boat here? Keep turning left.
Does his tone sound a bit languid?
Turn left oops, misread that! Turn right
why is it getting all emotional?!
Is it giving me bogus directions
because it misread the map?!
Turn right toll booth fifty meters ahead.
A toll booth right in front of me ?! I cannot see a thing !
What is this toll booth even for ?!
Oh saved me ten bucks ,
but now this level's prize money is zero !
So , paying with that voucher is mandatory now ?!
This lousy nav is turning again!
one hundred meters ahead, turn right for one hundred meters.
OK, going to turn here ...
one hundred meters ahead,
entering speed restricted area
wait, a speed restricted area?
Where is it restricted?
Left turn, left turn yep,
turning left really slows things down!
Keep turning left ahead ... so slow!
What a lousy driver I am!
Left turn?! Were not you the one
who led me into this speed limit zone?!
Go straight. Left turn at the intersection ahead, left turn,
then keep going straight. O K, straight ahead.
And then what?
U turn in fifty meters ahead. A U turn in fifty meters?!
Did I go the wrong way?
Where? Oh, U turn here, fine. Left turn.
A U turn, for real?!
Feels like I just got laughed at for no reason!
Dang it! Turn right ahead—turn right ahead! Please just leave the delivery code at the door, thanks!
Left turn! You are a real person, right?! You sound so nice talking to that delivery guy, but this is the tone you use with me?! Left turn! Hey, do not eat and navigate at the same time! Fine!
Give me some! What are you eating?!
Let me have a bite! Turn right,
oh, you finished it already?! You ate that fast!
Nearing destination! Destination oh, this spot!
So this place is the finish line!
Navigation is over, huh!
Should have known better than to tap so much
now I am feeling sleepy again.
How come you did not hang up?!
Do I have to be the one to end the call?!
Oh, this spot right here yep, I can click it!
Level cleared next one!
Hmm two different colors ... but I cannot click this level
what does that mean ?!
Can I press the keyboard? Oh!
I am Snake!
okay! Snake cannot hit the walls!
Spin around okay, oops, wait, missed it! Let us try again. Okay!
Did it just speed up?
It sped up ? ! Okay, okay, okay this is getting tough !
This is set up to make me lose!
If the game ends now,
would not that send me right back to square one?!
Revive by watching an ad sure, why not!
Hey, when you have your I D card out,
queuing up for security checks
at the train station or airport,
worried folks might glimpse your vital info?
Then clothe your I D card!
Warma will shield your privacy for you.
Vital info no peeking by others!
Just slip it in this card holder
and you can scan it right through security!
Oh, and an epic breath
holding champ will watch over it for you
I will hold my breath until you put that I D card back!
Grab your I D easily, no more baring your privacy! Shop
via the link below the video!
Oh, right, I also made a button that can blow up the Earth!
Getting that button is so simple! Jumped! Finally jumped!
Fight the Landlord am I the Landlord?
These two Farmers are acquaintances—Black crowned Night Heron and Hen! I will go first—my hand is so good! Uh ... I will play a single card ... how about this? A six, a seven, and a nine!
A two!
Okay, easy peasy just compare sizes! You have the Big Joker?! Hmm, then I will not make you go first. three, eleven ... and then I will wait.
Not J, Q, K, or whatnot? Eleven?!
Oh! So this is a spot the difference game
that eleven card clearly is not part of a standard deck!
Haha, the creator is a genius!
Next level! Ah, this is a building
and I can click this window!
I go to bed at eight P M every night.
Wow! You sleep so early!
Sleeping past ten P M
just shaves years off your life—I will not do it!
Oh—so I did not hear that shaving years off bit
and went to bed at ten P M.
Early to bed,
early to rise
enjoy life,
whole family’s routine is healthy!
They are all early to bed, early to rise types! Every night, some neighbor stays up late so noisy! Who?! me, early to bed?! Do I look like the kind who stays up late?! I am healthy, okay?!
Next door, in the dead of night so noisy! This one next door?
Only three A M is the best! Praise be to the late night!
Praise late nights!
I get it!
He must be the only one in this building
who stays up late click him!
Oh! Wait no! I just noticed there is a time bar down here
I can change the time! See, come afternoon,
everyone has got their lights on,
because it has gotten dark, right?
Come nighttime, everyone is asleep
only his light is still on!
What time does he even sleep?! Oh six A M?! Man,
he can really pull an all nighter!
Let me see when only his light is on,
you are the one that is different to click!
Heh heh, what the ?! Fine, fine, stop nagging!
I will go to sleep! A bit cranky, huh?
Next level!
Mmm oh!
I have something to tell you.
From the very first day I saw you,
my brain just stopped working! A confession?!
Especially that time
I accidentally brushed against your hand
it felt like a jolt of electricity shot right through me!
It was winter back then—static electricity!
Oh, yeah, that's right.
Anyway, I finally realized that actually, for you ...
um ... is it *this* much love?!
Plus, this color is a bit darker
it must be different.
Let us click it!
Dark in the literal sense ?
I have had a secret crush on you all along ,
but I do not want to hide it in my heart anymore
I want to tell you openly now !
Just now, it got blocked!
What did you say?!
I could not hear a thing!
What an unlucky fellow!
Why is there a shared power bank in the next level?
Can I scan this Q R code?
Let me give it a scan.
Oh! There it is this thing?
Because all the others are tucked away,
but this one popped out!
Mine! Next level a quiz!
Say you are trapped on a snowy mountain,
shivering away,
you can pick one extra piece of clothing
to boost your odds of survival.
So, eagerly, you would choose, logically speaking,
keeping your upper body warm
might boost your odds of survival.
A top, then!
Hmm, is that wrong?
What about pants, then?
Like a brain teaser!
Could the way to clear this be hidden somewhere else?
Where can I click?
Wait was a typo just corrected?
Among all the correct words, that one was the only typo!
So, anyway, just clear the stage!
I clicked randomly and landed on the next level
made it this far through all those challenges,
good work!
Here, have a piece of waffle!
Wow, it does look like a waffle—how do I eat it?
Just click it!
Hahahaha! Was it tasty?
Oh! All done! All done! I am full thanks!
Oh! Time to face the boss? He looks so evil and he is an emoji!
A tiny waffle to scarf down but that waffle is just bait!
Want the prize money?
The prize is in this chest—do not even dream
of taking a single penny!
Ah! I get it! Beat him, and I get the cash!
But forget about ever getting that chest!
Hah! This is the world’s fastest blade—
you are doomed!
What blade?! Attack nine hundred and ninety nine?!
The fastest blade?!
What do I do?!
Uh, if I attack it, I have no weapons! To defend,
I have no shield,
and if I flee ... well, fleeing means no cash!
I think taunting is the only way now irritate it,
and it will grow enraged, and rage will dull its wits.
Let me try taunting wait, am I really gonna taunt it?!
Can I even choose who to taunt?!
What does  taunt the knife  even mean?!
Let us taunt this knife first
maybe we can find its weak spot!
Do I have to pick the taunt lines, too?!  Please, I beg you, spare me!  that is not taunting! What does that even mean?! Hmm, well ... I guess I have no choice but to pick this one.
You are the dumbest blade in the world!
The dumbest!
You ... called me dumb ... ?!
No one is ever called me dumb!   Is big bro crying ?!
Ah! It died! It turned into a not fast knife!
Why would you say such unpleasant things?!
Unpleasant, you say? Just now, it was the fastest blade
does fastest equate to not fast?!
Hello there!
My blade is not sharp anymore!
Hahaha!
This pisses me off!
I shall blow you up!
Wait— Big Bang, charging up!
Oh no, no, no!
What do I do?!
Countdown, six seconds! Five degrees! Aaaargh!
Ugh cannot even click the blade!
Cannot click it!
Why cannot I move?! Argh!
Come on, hurry up! Bro is going to cut and paste you over here!
HOOLA! Quick thinking on my part,
I confined the explosion WITHIN this text box,
so it did not blow up my game! Ha!
Now let me see what I have got,
let us check how much cash is in this treasure chest!
thousand one hundred and eighty ... is not that a bit low ?
Were not they talking about a massive prize at the start ?
When I hear massive , I am thinking in the millions !
Wait—why is there a convenience store?!
Screwdriver sale! Bought one!
Would not even sell for one hundred bucks in real life
though I have no idea what it is for,
I will buy one to try!
Bought it!
Can I use it?
My mouse turned into a screwdriver!
Hmm, looks like I can twist this,
is this a part? I thought I would twist that plus sign!
It spun! The plus sign turned into a times sign!
And this number got multiplied by ten!
This one, too times ten! Plus changed to times!
What a huge number!
Times, times, times!
Ones, tens, hundreds, thousands, ten millions, one billion, ten billion, one hundred billion! Is all this for me?! I have hit the jackpot! wooow! It truly is a massive prize! Oh my god, thank you!
Huh? Cannot I click it? still cannot click it?!
Did not I just clear the stage?!
Where is the button?!
Why did this one vanish?!
So that one was the odd one out?
